campaign_name: Mission Taqueria Late Night Al Pastor
brief: Late-night al pastor tacos carved fresh off the trompo until 2 AM, two blocks from the 24th St Mission BART. Order ahead on the link and skip the line after the show. CTA: Order ahead and skip the line.
audience: night-out crowd and late-shift workers, 21-35, leaving shows, bars and BART after 10 PM
